issues.message:

AgentF4562_Amortization.label: Amortization (Part VI)
AgentF4562_Amortization.summary: Part VI (Amortization) = $0 per current books. First-year LLC: CPA should verify closing statement for §709/§195 costs and loan origination points (§461(g)(2)).

issues.message:
$0 amortization — no intangible costs recorded in the books.
  • W&B Group is in its first year — a CPA should confirm whether formation or startup costs were paid.
  • Attorney fees and state filing fees for forming the LLC may be partially deductible (up to $5,000), with the rest spread over 15 years.
  • Costs incurred before the property opened for rental may also qualify as startup costs under the same rules.
issues.irs_cite: IRC §709(b); IRC §195(b); Form 4562 Part VI Lines 42-43
issues.action: Review formation documents. If organization/startup costs exist, capitalize in llcAssets and complete Part VI Lines 42-43.

issues.message:
$227,858.23 in closing costs found in the books — a CPA review is needed to classify each item correctly.
  • Loan origination points: must be spread over the life of the loan (not a one-time deduction)
  • Prepaid interest: deductible in the year it accrues
  • Title and transfer taxes: added to the property's cost basis (increases future depreciation deduction)
issues.irs_cite: IRC §461(g)(2); IRC §195; IRC §263; Form 4562 Part VI; Pub 527
issues.action: Review closing statement line by line. Identify loan origination points. Amortize points over loan term — annual amount to Form 8825 Line 12.

issues.message:
Reminder: Points paid on a rental mortgage must be spread over the loan term — not deducted all at once.
  • This is different from a primary residence, where points are often immediately deductible.
  • The annual portion of points flows to Form 8825 Line 12 (mortgage interest).
  • Check the H_805HighMesa closing statement to see if any origination points were paid.
issues.action: Review H_805HighMesa closing statement for origination fees/points. If present: amortize over loan term; add annual amount to Form 8825 Line 12.
